scripts.api_dev: bunx prisma generate --schema=api_backend/prisma/schema.prisma && bun run --filter api-backend dev
scripts.telemetry:seek: bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml exec redpanda-0 sh -lc "set -eu; for topic in rmm_telemetry_snapshots rmm_telemetry_events rmm_telemetry_remediation_commands rmm_telemetry_remediation_status rmm_telemetry_patch_progress; do rpk group seek rmm-telemetry-snapshot-consumer --to start --topics \"$topic\" --allow-new-topics --brokers redpanda-0:9092 || { echo \"Failed to reset group offsets for topic '$topic'. Stop any running talos_telemetry_consumer process and rerun this command.\" >&2; exit 1; }; done"
scripts.telemetry:up: bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redpanda-0 console azurite && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm topic-init
scripts.infra:up: bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redpanda-0 console azurite && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm topic-init
scripts.docker:rust-servers: bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts build -f ../infra/Dockerfile.rust-servers --target talos_server -t talos/talos-server:dev .. && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts build -f ../infra/Dockerfile.rust-servers --target talos_relay -t talos/talos-relay:dev .. && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts build -f ../infra/Dockerfile.rust-servers --target talos_telemetry_consumer -t talos/talos-telemetry-consumer:dev .. && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts build -f ../infra/Dockerfile.rust-servers --target talos_telemetry_producer -t talos/talos-telemetry-producer:dev .. && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts build -f ../infra/Dockerfile.rust-servers --target talos_ai_runner -t talos/talos-ai-runner:dev ..
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run check:scripts && bun run community:production:check && bun run community:edge:check && bun run installer:versions:check && bun run installer:signing:check && bun run signing:secrets:check && bun run release:inputs:check && bun run release:pipeline:check && bun run license:check && bun run publication:check && bun run --sequential --workspaces --if-present check
scripts.test: bun run scripts:test && bun run --sequential --workspaces --if-present test
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --keep-going -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p talos_protocol --all-targets --features typescript --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.quality: bun run toolchain:check && bun run workspace:check && bun install --frozen-lockfile --dry-run && bun run contracts:check && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run audit:js && bun run check:rust && bun run test:rust && bun run audit:rust
scripts.rust-servers:up: bun ./scripts/up-rust-servers.ts && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --no-build talos_server talos_relay talos_telemetry_consumer talos_telemetry_producer talos_ai_runner
scripts.app-services:up: bun ./scripts/up-app-services.ts && bun ./scripts/run-docker.mts compose -f ../infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --no-build api_backend frontend talos_server talos_relay talos_telemetry_consumer talos_telemetry_producer talos_ai_runner
